messages.body_plain:
Hi Qian Ding,

How many hours of data are there in the file you are trying to analyse? It could be that the measurement is too short and does not include any midnights.

Further, I notice that you use a 60 second epoch. Nowadays hardly anyone is using that anymore because it is known to limit the sensitivity to short lasting behaviours. This setting should not impact on the ability to identify midnight, but it may still be worth checking: Can you try replacing the 60 by 5?

Best, Vincent

messages.body_plain:
Hi Natalie,

Your interpretation is correct.

The 50 versus 150 threshold for the ranger criteria (racriter) may have been an incorrect copy/paste of the parameters used in my earlier papers on the GENEA accelerometer which did have less noise.
However, my understanding now is that this racriter is mostly redundant. I added it as an intuitive safety check, but non-wear detection seems to work equally well without it.

Finally, it may be worth mentioning in relation to my code comments "adjustment needed..." that the Actigraph data I have seen indicate that the 0.013 criteria works fine. Further, UKBiobank has been using the 0.013 criteria in their copy of my non-wear detection algorithm for their Axivity data.

Best, Vincent

Dear all,
GGIR version 1.3-2 is now online. Main novelty is "part5". This
function merges the previously available output on general summary
(part2) and noon-to-noon sleep characteristics (part4) into one report
enhanced with profiling of intensity levels based on bouted periods as
well as non-bouted periods. For example, time spent in, average
acceleration of and number of periods per level. Further, you can
choose to either derive variables from midnight to midnight or from
waking-up in the morning to waking-up the next morning, and derive
them per day and per week.

In the g.shell.GGIR you could for example specify:
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 5 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             # Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses
             threshold.lig = c(30,40,50),
             threshold.mod = c(100,120),
             threshold.vig = c(400,500),
             boutcriter = 0.8,
             boutcriter.in <http://boutcriter.in> = 0.9,
             boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
             boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8,
             boutdur.in <http://boutdur.in> = c(10,20,30),
             boutdur.lig = c(1,5,10),
             boutdur.mvpa = c(1,5,10),
             timewindow = c("WW"),
in combination with argument mode = 5.

I have done an effort to document everything in the tutorial, but if
you spot mistakes or if something is not clear then let me know.

Best, Vincent
